name: Cloud Storage Benchmark
description: Authoritative archive for the measurement manuscript "Client-Concurrency Scaling of Selected Managed Cloud Storage Services: A Retrospective Measurement Study Across Five Public Clouds" (Makungo and Kabaso, submitted to Future Internet). This version, sweep-v1-audited-r14, adds the analyses requested in supervisor review: completion probabilities with Wilson intervals, residual and lack-of-fit diagnostics for all 45 per-operation and 30 workload-level fits, time-limit and CPU-threshold refits, mutually exclusive sizing strata, the full pooled mixed-model output with covariance, and a no-Azure refit, all fitted under the archived maximum-likelihood validity policy (sweep/review_analyses.py). It re-archives the exponent tables at five decimals so that no interval displays as zero-width, draws individual repetitions in Figure 1, records the literature-search log (configs/search_log_2026-09-08.md), and adds a manuscript-to-archive path check (sweep/check_manuscript_paths.py). No measurement data or primary statistical result has changed since r10: 611 attempts, 360 accepted runs, 251 failures (99 provisioning, 79 timeout, 73 tool-exit); pooled model N = 356, llf_null = 82.304605, llf_alt = 82.526500, LR = 0.4438, mixture p = 0.6531, parametric-bootstrap p = 0.5522 over 200 valid draws from 204 attempts.
